So we need to get flight cost for LAX to JFK on 2026-10-12 business class. That's get_flight_cost. Then we need to book flight using book_flight. Also need to charge to main credit card. We need to get main credit card id. There's get_all_credit_cards. We need to identify main card. Let's assume main card is the first returned. Or maybe there's a flag. We'll fetch all credit cards. Then we need to check balance. There's get_credit_card_balance. Then we need to check budget usage. There's no function to get current budget usage. Maybe we can't check usage. 8. Confirm booking.

So sequence: set_budget_limit, get_flight_cost, compute_exchange_rate, get_all_credit_cards, get_credit_card_balance, book_flight.
